name: @rhema/live-clients
description: Deploy-time bindings for the orchestrator DI seams (D-P0.08-1/08b-1): the pg.Pool TxRunner, the Redis heartbeat store + run-event pub/sub, the pg-boss queue, the GKE Job launcher, and the Secret Manager RS256 key source. Thin wrappers over heavy client libraries — constructed at deploy, exercised live; the pure manifest/encoding logic is unit-tested here.
